headline: High: Airbyte’s broad egress plus Superset’s allowlisted egress create a default data-exfiltration and compliance-risk pathway when paired, with additional medium prompt-injection and cascading-error exposure.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airbyte can move data through APIs and broad egress, and Superset consumes analytics/data outputs via its API. If Airbyte forwards untrusted content into datasets or dashboards that Superset later interprets, instruction-like payloads can cross the pair. The interaction is inferred from documented surfaces, not directly observed, so uncertainty pushes above low.
conditions: IF Airbyte ingests attacker-controlled text into a dataset that Superset later renders or parses as instructions
IF Superset automation consumes Airbyte-produced content without provenance filtering
mitigations: Disable any auto-rendering of raw text fields in Superset
Add provenance labels to Airbyte-fed datasets
Require manual review before dashboarding untrusted records
Restrict Airbyte syncs to sanitized tables
requires-engineering: add content-safety filters between Airbyte and Superset

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airbyte touches business data and has broad network egress, while Superset has allowlisted egress and can expose queried data through its API. In a shared pipeline, sensitive business data can flow from Airbyte into Superset outputs or outbound requests. Because the pairwise data path is plausible by default and one side can transmit outward, the safer choice is high.
conditions: IF Airbyte syncs business data into a Superset-accessible workspace
IF Superset queries or exports those records through its API or allowlisted egress
mitigations: Limit Airbyte syncs to non-sensitive schemas
Remove sensitive columns before Superset ingestion
Tighten Superset egress allowlists
Audit API exports for business data
requires-engineering: segregate sensitive and non-sensitive workspaces

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents are data-engineering systems with API surfaces and outbound network capability, so they can contend over shared mutable resources if orchestrated together. No locking or isolation is documented, and the profiles do not prove disjoint storage. This is not high because unrestricted same-directory writes are not shown, but overlap is credible enough for medium.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same downstream dataset or metadata store
IF the orchestrator does not serialize updates or enforce locks
mitigations: Assign separate write targets
Enable optimistic concurrency checks
Schedule non-overlapping sync windows
Add dataset-level locks
requires-engineering: introduce a coordination layer

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airbyte can produce transformed business data, and Superset can consume that data through its API for analytics. If Superset treats Airbyte output as authoritative without validation, upstream extraction or transformation errors can cascade into incorrect dashboards or actions. The pairwise pathway is plausible but not directly evidenced, so medium fits better than low.
conditions: IF Superset dashboards or automations consume Airbyte outputs without validation
IF Airbyte transformation errors are not checked before publication
mitigations: Add validation checks on Airbyte outputs
Require reconciliation against source systems
Mark derived fields as untrusted until reviewed
Use canary datasets for new pipelines
requires-engineering: add automated data-quality gates

E_compliance.rationale: Airbyte explicitly touches business data and has broad egress, while Superset has allowlisted egress and no touched data classes are listed. That creates a plausible retention/residency/compliance mismatch if the pair handles regulated business records, even though no specific jurisdiction is documented. Uncertainty keeps this at medium rather than low.
conditions: IF regulated business data is routed through both agents
IF their logging or retention settings differ for the same dataset
mitigations: Review retention settings in both systems
Exclude regulated fields from Airbyte syncs
Document data residency for each pipeline
Restrict exports from Superset
requires-engineering: align compliance controls across the pair
